entries.name: office_excel_get_overview
entries.label: Excel Workbook Overview
entries.description: Read a compact overview of the attached Excel workbook: sheet names, used ranges, table names, and named ranges. Call this first before any range operation.
entries.promptSnippet: Outline the attached Excel workbook
promptGuidelines: Call office_excel_get_overview before office_excel_read_range to learn the workbook structure.

sheet.description: If provided, return detailed info for this specific sheet (dimensions, headers, tables, named ranges, objects, and a data preview). If omitted, return the workbook-level overview.

entries.name: office_excel_read_range
entries.label: Excel Read Range
entries.description: Read cell values (and optionally formulas/formatting) from a range in the attached Excel workbook.
entries.promptSnippet: Read cells from the attached Excel workbook

range.description: Cell range in A1 notation, e.g. "A1:D10", "Sheet2!A1:B5". If no sheet is specified, uses the active sheet.

mode.description: "compact" (default): markdown table of values. "csv": values only as CSV. "detailed": includes formulas and number formats.

entries.name: office_excel_write_cells
entries.label: Excel Write Cells
entries.description: Write a 2D array of values into the attached Excel workbook, starting at a top-left cell. values[row][col]; the array is written down and to the right from start_cell.
entries.promptSnippet: Write values/formulas into the attached Excel workbook
promptGuidelines: Prefer office_excel_write_cells in a single batched call instead of many small edits.
Always verify with office_excel_read_range after office_excel_write_cells when the change is user-visible.

start_cell.description: Top-left cell to write from, e.g. "A1", "Sheet2!B3". If no sheet is specified, uses the active sheet.

values.description: 2D array of values. Each inner array is a row. Strings starting with "=" are formulas. Example: [["Name", "Total"], ["Alice", "=SUM(B2:B10)"]]

allow_overwrite.description: Set to true to overwrite existing data. Default: false. If false and the target range contains values or formulas, the write is blocked and the existing data is returned so you can ask the user.

entries.name: office_excel_fill_formula
entries.label: Excel Fill Formula
entries.description: Write a formula into a single contiguous range of the attached Excel workbook. Relative references adjust as the formula fills.
entries.promptSnippet: Fill a formula across an Excel range

range.description: Target range to fill, e.g. "B2:B20" or "Sheet1!C3:F20". Single contiguous range only.

formula.description: Formula to fill, starting with "=", e.g. "=SUM(B2:B10)". Relative refs will adjust.

allow_overwrite.description: Set to true to overwrite existing data. Default: false. If false and the target range contains data, the fill is blocked.

entries.name: office_excel_search_workbook
entries.label: Excel Search Workbook
entries.description: Search for text, values, or formulas across the attached Excel workbook. Returns matching cells with sheet name, address, value, and formula. Use to find data, locate cells by label, or trace cross-sheet references.
entries.promptSnippet: Search for text/values/formulas in the attached Excel workbook

query.description: Search term. For formula search, use references like "Sheet1!" to find cross-sheet links.

search_formulas.description: If true, search in formula text instead of values. Useful for finding cross-sheet references (e.g. query "Inputs!" to find all cells referencing Inputs sheet).

use_regex.description: If true, treat the query as a regular expression (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip the first N matches (pagination). Default: 0.

sheet.description: Restrict search to this sheet. If omitted, searches all sheets.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20.

context_rows.description: Number of rows above and below each match to include as context. Default: 0 (no context). Use 2-5 when searching for labels to see surrounding structure.

entries.name: office_excel_modify_structure
entries.label: Excel Modify Structure
entries.description: Modify the workbook structure of the attached Excel workbook: insert/delete rows and columns, add/delete/rename/duplicate/hide/unhide sheets. Be careful with deletions — there is no undo.
entries.promptSnippet: Insert/delete rows, columns, or sheets in the attached Excel workbook

sheet.description: Target sheet name. Required for sheet operations and row/column operations on a specific sheet. If omitted for row/column ops, uses the active sheet.

position.description: For insert_rows/delete_rows: the 1-indexed row number. For insert_columns/delete_columns: the 1-indexed column number. For add_sheet: the 0-indexed position to insert the new sheet.

count.description: Number of rows or columns to insert/delete. Default: 1.

new_name.description: New name for rename_sheet or add_sheet. Also used for duplicate_sheet target name.

entries.name: office_excel_format_cells
entries.label: Excel Format Cells
entries.description: Apply formatting to a range of cells in the attached Excel workbook (supports comma-separated ranges on one sheet). Use named styles for common patterns: style: "currency" or style: ["currency", "total-row"]. Individual params (bold, fill_color, etc.) override style properties. Does NOT modify cell values — use office_excel_write_cells for that.
entries.promptSnippet: Format cells (font, fill, borders, alignment, number format) in the attached Excel workbook

range.description: Range to format, e.g. "A1:D1", "Sheet2!B3:B20". Supports comma/semicolon-separated ranges on the same sheet (e.g. "A1:B2, D1:D2").

style.description: Named style(s) to apply. Compose as array (left-to-right). Format: "number", "integer", "currency", "percent", "ratio", "text". Structural: "header", "total-row", "subtotal", "input", "blank-section". Example: ["currency", "total-row"] = currency format + bold + top border.

underline.description: Underline. Pass true = "Single", false = "None"; or name a style directly: "None", "Single", "Double", "SingleAccountant", "DoubleAccountant".

indent_level.description: Indent level, 0-250. Needs ExcelApi 1.9; reports an error on older hosts.

font_color.description: Font color as hex, e.g. "#0000FF" for blue.

fill_color.description: Background fill color as hex, e.g. "#FFFF00" for yellow.

number_format.description: Preset name ("number", "integer", "currency", "percent", "ratio", "text") or raw Excel format string. Overrides style's number format.

number_format_dp.description: Override decimal places for a number format preset.

currency_symbol.description: Override currency symbol, e.g. "£", "€". Only with currency preset.

column_width.description: Set column width in Excel character-width units (assumes Arial 10).

auto_fit.description: Auto-fit column widths to content. Default: false.

borders.description: Border weight for ALL edges (shorthand). Individual edge params override this.

border_color.description: Hex color for borders (e.g. "#000000"). Applies to all borders set in this call. Default: automatic (black).

border_style.description: Border line style applied to every border set in this call. Default "Continuous". "Dash", "DashDot", "DashDotDot", "Dot", "Double" and "SlantDashDot" give the full Excel line-style set (ExcelApi 1.1).

merge.description: Merge the range into a single cell.

entries.name: office_excel_conditional_format
entries.label: Excel Conditional Format
entries.description: Add or clear conditional formatting rules in the attached Excel workbook. Supports custom formula and cell value rules.
entries.promptSnippet: Add or clear conditional formatting rules in the attached Excel workbook

action.description: "add" to create a rule, "clear" to remove all rules in the range.

type.description: Rule family for "add" (all ExcelApi 1.6). "formula" = custom formula, "cell_value" = comparison, "data_bar", "color_scale", "icon_set", "top_bottom", "preset_criteria" (blanks/average/dates/unique), "contains_text".

operator.description: Cell value operator (required for cell_value rules).

value.description: Cell value comparison target (required for cell_value rules). Use numbers or formulas like "=$B$2".

top_bottom_rank.description: Rank for type="top_bottom": 1-1000 for item ranks, 1-100 for percent ranks. Default 10.

data_bar_show_only.description: Show the data bar only, hiding the cell value.

color_scale_mid_color.description: Midpoint color for type="color_scale". Omit for a two-color scale.

icon_set_show_icon_only.description: Show only the icon, hiding the cell value.

stop_if_true.description: Stop evaluating later rules if true.

entries.label: Excel Charts
entries.description: List, create, update, delete, and capture images of charts in the attached Excel workbook.
entries.promptSnippet: List/create/update/delete charts in the attached Excel workbook

action.description: Chart operation: list, create, update, delete, or get_image.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. For list, limits output to one sheet. For create/update, defaults to the active sheet or the source range sheet.

name.description: Chart name. Required for update, delete, and get_image. Optional assigned name for create.

source_range.description: Source data range for create/update, e.g. `Sheet1!A1:B12` or `A1:B12` relative to sheet.

chart_type.description: Chart type: column, column_stacked, column_stacked_100, bar, bar_stacked, bar_stacked_100, line, line_markers, area, area_stacked, pie, doughnut, scatter, scatter_lines, scatter_smooth, or radar.

series_by.description: How source rows/columns become series: auto, columns, or rows.

legend_position.description: Legend position, or none to hide the legend.

y_axis_title.description: Value/Y axis title. Empty string hides it.

position.description: Anchor range for chart placement, e.g. `D2:J18`.

width.description: Image width in pixels for get_image. Defaults to 600; capped at 1200.

entries.name: office_excel_trace_dependencies

entries.promptSnippet: Trace formula precedents/dependents of an Excel cell

mode.description: Trace direction: precedents (upstream) or dependents (downstream). Default: precedents.

entries.name: office_word_insert_text
entries.label: Word Insert Text
entries.description: Insert text into the attached Word document — at the start, at the end (default), or replacing the current selection. Multi-line text becomes separate paragraphs. Optionally format the inserted text in the same call: font (bold, italic, underline, size, name, color), paragraph alignment ("Left"/"Centered"/"Right"/"Justified"), style names (e.g. "Heading 1", "Title"), spacing, and indents. Use format: "markdown" to insert a markdown document (headings, bold/italic, bullets). Only the formatting properties listed above are exposed — if the user asks for one that is not listed, say it is not available rather than claiming support.
entries.promptSnippet: Insert (and format) text into the attached Word document
promptGuidelines: For a formatted document use office_word_insert_blocks (precise per-block control) or office_word_insert_text with format: "markdown".
Never emit HTML for Word documents; use office_word_insert_text / office_word_insert_blocks instead.

text.description: Text to insert. Newlines create separate paragraphs.

location.description: "end" (default) appends to the document. "replace_selection" overwrites the selection.

format.description: "text" (default): plain text with newline→paragraph. "markdown": parse a markdown subset.

highlight.description: Text highlight (marker) color as #RRGGBB, or "none" to clear. This is what a "fill"/"background"/"highlight" request on text maps to. Available on Word desktop and Word for the web (WordApi 1.1); on Word for Windows desktop a value outside the 15 named highlight colors snaps to the nearest one.

alignment.description: Paragraph alignment. Word values: "Left", "Centered" (note the capital C), "Right", "Justified".

style.description: Paragraph style name, e.g. "Heading 1", "Title", "Normal". Style names are locale-sensitive; a fallback to direct formatting is applied when the style cannot be verified.

spaceAfter.description: Space after the paragraph, in points.

Its span depends on the tool: word_format_range fills only the matched text, while word_insert_text / word_insert_blocks fill the whole paragraph. Use `highlight` instead for a character-level marker that works on every platform.
